responsibility: Defines the Modula-2 interface to the C lexical scanner used by gm2’s C-facing support tools. It exports source open/close, token retrieval and advancement, current line-number reporting, formatted lexer error emission, a mode switch that suppresses parsing outside selected preprocessor-condition lines, search-path reassignment, and typedef-name registration, so higher-level code can consume C tokens without depending directly on the underlying scanner implementation.
